subject: Re: Kickoff: logit adjustment for long-tail classifiers — rollout decision
body:
Team,

Pilot wrapped Friday; decision time.

- Result: on the partner's workload the adjusted trainer improved tail-class accuracy 7.8pp with a 0.4pp overall dip — inside their tolerance. Carmen's smoothed-frequency variant was needed for the <20-example classes exactly as she predicted; without it the raw estimates were too noisy.
- Decision: rollout approved. The flag goes to generally-available in the platform trainer this month, default-off, with the smoothed variant as the documented recommendation for extreme tails. Linnea's Evalline long-tail metrics ship alongside so teams can see per-class effects instead of a single top-1 number.
- Farah — the May push made the pilot; the integration issue list (11 filed, 11 closed) tells the story. Please write the two-page rollout note by Jun 5 and we'll close this one out.

Dmitri
